messages:
marie (support): Filing customer escalation from AcmeMobile — they see p95/p99 spikes for function-calling requests after yesterday's tool-router rollout. customer reports app timeouts, started ~09:15 UTC.
ajay (eng-runtime): ack. which router build did we push?
marie (support): looks like tool-router v2.3.1 + structured-output-validator v1.8 enabled by default. customer attached timings: avg latency normal, but p95~1.2s -> 3.8s and p99 -> 6.4s on calls that include JSON schema validation.
sofia (eng-ml): interesting — validation runs before model call or after? could be blocking batch scheduler.
ajay (eng-runtime): our change moved schema validation into the per-request sync path in front of batching to protect downstream tools. that could add per-request overhead.
kevin (product): they said only function-calling endpoints affected, non-tool generation unchanged?
marie (support): yes, plain text/chat endpoints stable. only requests with tool calls and structured_output schema see spikes.
ajay (eng-runtime): can we get a sample request and timings from customer? ask for request id header.
marie (support): pasted their minimal repro curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"get-weather","function_call":{"name":"weather","arguments":{"city":"sf"},"response_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"temp":{"type":"number"},"units":{"type":"string"}},"required":["temp"]}}' -H 'X-Request-ID: acme-1709'```
marie (support): customer timing header breakdown (sample): ```
Auth: 12ms
Router dispatch: 180ms
Schema validation: 210ms
Model exec + kv cache: 240ms
Total: ~642ms (p95/p99 much higher intermittently)
```
ajay (eng-runtime): 180ms router dispatch + 210ms validation is the problem. router should be <30ms. router dispatch includes tool resolution + policy checks now. maybe the validation lib does JSON-schema draft7 synchronous parse which is slow on some inputs.
sofia (eng-ml): also check that validation isn't triggering fallback to full parse of large tool catalogs; we added a catalog lookup in v2.3.1. if catalog hits are serial it can spike.
ajay (eng-runtime): loading the tool catalog from Redis on miss can add ~150ms. thought we cached keys. need logs.
ops-bot: deploy-bot reports: tool-router v2.3.1 deployed 2026-03-16T09:11:00Z across region us-west-2. Structured validator v1.8 enabled by default.
marie (support): customer provided request ids: acme-1709, acme-1710, acme-1711 — attached in thread. they see p99 up to 6.4s and timeouts at 10s.
ajay (eng-runtime): immediate mitigations: 1) flip validator to async/behind-batching for affected routes (non-blocking), 2) disable validator for that tenant or route, 3) force in-memory cached catalog for the cluster. Which can we do fastest?
sofia (eng-ml): fastest is tenant-scoped disable toggle. we have per-tenant flags in control-plane. do that and monitor.
kevin (product): agree temporary toggle for AcmeMobile while we investigate. also need long term: move validation to a separate validation service or run after model if safe.
ajay (eng-runtime): I'll open a rollback/workaround PR: - control-plane flag for structured-output-validation = false for tenant id acme-mobile - hotfix to populate LRU in-process cache for tool catalog - add metrics for schema validation latency (histogram).
marie (support): doing toggle now, ping when complete.
marie (support): toggled structured-output-validation=false for tenant acme-mobile via control-plane. please confirm effect. :white_check_mark:
ajay (eng-runtime): confirmed flag reached edge nodes. monitoring p95 for their requests now.
marie (support): customer reports initial improvement: p95 dropped from ~3.8s to ~800ms. p99 still has a few spikes ~2.1s.
sofia (eng-ml): spikes may be cold-catalog misses. need to warm on startup or prefetch per-tenant. also worth profiling validator on common schemas — some patterns (deep nested oneOf) are expensive.
ajay (eng-runtime): collecting traces. asking infra to provide call traces for request ids acme-1709..1715. trace shows cache miss -> redis read (~120ms) + sync validation (~200ms) -> model.
kevin (product): next steps for customer: 1) keep validation off while we deploy fixes, 2) set SLA workarounds (increase timeout), 3) timeline?
ajay (eng-runtime): ETA: hotfix to in-process catalog cache + metrics in next 2 hrs, then promote async validation prototype in 24-48 hrs. longer term: move validation to worker pipeline and add tokenized validation stubs.
marie (support): customer asked for repro steps we used — posted the curl + mention of flag toggle. they were appreciative.
sofia (eng-ml): tech notes for postmortem: - root cause: structured-output-validator introduced blocking sync validation and catalog lookup in router path. - contributing factor: catalog misses not warmed and Redis latency higher than expected. - impact: p95/p99 increase for tenant function calls, timeouts for some requests. - mitigations: tenant toggle, in-process cache, move validation off critical path, add unit tests for heavy schema patterns.
ajay (eng-runtime): I'll add a short-term opt: skip schema validation for small schemas (<2KB) and for known simple shapes — safer and cheap.
kevin (product): schedule a customer follow-up: apologize + explain fix plan + offer a one-month credits for impact. handle in comms.
marie (support): I'll draft message and include our mitigations + ETA.
marie (support): closing loop with customer now. thanks team. :heart:
__meta: generated for dataset: slack threads about latency/customer escalations; single continuous message string; no title per agents.md
